questions.prompt: The shell splits a line into words. What does word 0 become?
You type `echo one     two` and see `one two`. Who collapsed the whitespace?

options.a: echo trims repeated spaces from its input string
options.b: the terminal rewrites the line as you type
options.c: the shell split the line into two words before echo ran; echo just joins its argv with single spaces

options.b: what the program receives — one argument instead of two
options.c: nothing; quotes are stripped before anything else happens
